title: Tensor-form degree-zero canonical mate square
statement: Choose shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$ be morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with fibre projections $v:X\times_S T\to X$, $p:X\times_S T\to T$. Assume additive tensor pullback along $v$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and injective resolutions on $X\times_S T$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module for which $M=f_*G$ is finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Put $K=Rf_*(G[0])$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $a=u_f(G):M[0]\to K$ [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison], and $H=H^0$ on $T$. There are an isomorphism $e_0:g^*M\cong H(Lg^*(M[0]))$ and a morphism $\varphi:Lg^*K\to Rp_*((v^*G)[0])$ satisfying IsDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map], such that the specified ordinary map $\beta$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] equals $e_0.\mathrm{hom}\gg H(Lg^*a)\gg H(\varphi)\gg z.\mathrm{hom}$, where $z:H(Rp_*((v^*G)[0]))\cong p_*v^*G$ is canonicalDirectImageH0Iso [lem-pc-canonical-degree-zero-mate-square]. No geometric condition or invertibility of $\varphi$ is asserted.

proof.text: Take the pinned left-derived counit of tensor pullback supplied by exists_derivedPullbackComposition. At G[0] compose it with the single-complex comparison to form c. Compose derived base change with Rp_*(c) to obtain phi. Its characterising predicate follows by unpacking IsDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap.

M is finite locally free, so its affine sections are projective and hence flat. Thus M[0] is K-flat and the counit is invertible there. Its inverse and the single-complex homology identification give e0.

Apply derivedBaseChange_unit_compatibility to the single complex G[0]. Naturality of the pinned tensor-pullback counit and of the right-derived direct-image unit reduce the desired single-object square to the termwise ordinary exchange map. The singleMapHomologicalComplex comparisons identify this exchange map with singleFunctor.map(moduleBaseChangeMap). This identity follows by degree-zero component extensionality, functor identity laws and the definitions of the complex comparison maps. It descends to the homotopy category by the quotient functor.

Apply H0 to the resulting single-object square. canonicalDirectImageH0Unit identifies H0 of the direct-image unit followed by the canonical direct-image H0 isomorphism with the single-homology identification. Naturality of the single-homology isomorphism identifies the ordinary map. Cancel the invertible H0 source comparison to obtain the displayed formula. Neither phi nor beta is cancelled.

theorem tensorDegreeZeroMateSquare
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S)
    [(tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Limits.pullback f g).Modules]
    (G : X.Modules) [((pushforward f).obj G).IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    let M := (pushforward f).obj G
    let K := (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G)
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0
    ∃ (e0 : (tensorPullback g).obj M ≅
        H.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)))
      (φ : (derivedPullback g).obj K ⟶
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj G))),
      IsDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap f g G φ ∧
      moduleBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition G =
        e0.hom ≫ H.map ((derivedPullback g).map (canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f G)) ≫
          H.map φ ≫ (canonicalDirectImageH0Iso (pullback.snd f g)
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj G)).hom
